explication: Tonkatsu Box is a cross-platform Flutter personal media collection manager. Users discover titles through many catalogs or import existing libraries, add and organize items into collections, track progress and ratings, then inspect statistics and visual organization views. The main internal layer is the repository/database boundary, which centralizes library persistence for collection, tracking, import, and analytics features. The sampled source primarily confirms native platform entry points; feature relationships are therefore based on the README and exact directory structure, with uncertain low-level calls omitted.
